title: The Kernel

theme: The motif slowed to half notes in C minor (C G C Eb D C): the theme become a hymn.
form: silence 1, intro 4 (low harp and bells), verse 8 (horn), bridge 8 (strings rise, Ab major), verse 8 (full), outro 2
